QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] False Charges
QuestInfo.0: The Assassins fled, but YOU were the one standing over the Heaven Empire envoy's body when help arrived. You're in a pickle!
QuestInfo.1: The Assassins fled, but YOU were the one standing over the Heaven Empire envoy's body when help arrived. You're in a pickle! Vaughn Tremier insisted that you were the culprit.
QuestInfo.2: The Assassins fled, but YOU were the one standing over the Heaven Empire envoy's body when help arrived. You're in a pickle! Vaughn Tremier insisted that you were the culprit, but the Robed Lady saved you from arrest.
